title: Meet the FAQ guy
thisBuild: Your grinning paper drawing is now the FAQ guy, redrawn in NSD colours to match the other icons.
He is the What the FAQ button, and he does the talking in What the FAQ, the lessons, the speed guide and this start guide.
He sits inside each card, so he never covers anything, and hops when he says something new.
watch: Tap the FAQ button, then a few controls: does he read as a face at that size?
Run one lesson and the speed guide: does the hop feel fun or annoying?
limits: Your newest bug notes have not reached GitHub yet. Open Notes in the menu and send any that are waiting.
The bug video waits on Hugging Face being allowed, so its fixes are not in this build.
